text: 一、个人转让上市公司限售股取得的所得，按照“财产转让所得”，适用20%税率缴纳个人所得税。本公告所称限售股包括《财政部 国家税务总局 证监会关于个人转让上市公司限售股所得征收个人所得税有关问题的通知》（财税〔2009〕167号）第二条规定的限售股，以及其在解禁日后孳生且在本公告实施后办理股权登记的送、转股。 限售股发生送、转、缩股的，证券登记结算公司应当依据送、转、缩股比例对限售股成本原值进行调整。
text_en: 1. Income derived by individuals from transferring restricted shares of listed companies shall be subject to individual income tax at a rate of 20% under the category of income from transfer of property. Restricted shares as referred to in this announcement include restricted shares specified in Article 2 of the Notice on Issues Concerning the Collection of Individual Income Tax on Income from Transfer of Restricted Shares of Listed Companies by Individuals (Cai Shui [2009] No. 167) of the Ministry of Finance, the State Administration of Taxation, and the CSRC, as well as bonus shares and converted shares arising therefrom after the lifting of the lock-up period and registered as equity after the implementation of this announcement. When restricted shares undergo bonus share issuance, conversion, or share consolidation, the securities registration and settlement company should adjust the original cost of restricted shares based on the ratios of bonus shares, conversion, or consolidation.
